description_en: Queries the grouped view of the work item feed for active members with server-side cursor pagination
description_zh: 有效成员查询工作项 feed 分组视图；服务端游标分页（cursor/pageSize）
name: QueryWorkItemFeed

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The view type. Valid values: FLAT (flat view) and TREE (task grouping)
parameters.help_zh: 视图：FLAT 平铺 / TREE 任务分组
parameters.name: view

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Use the nextCursor value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 翻页游标，取上次响应的 nextCursor
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy search in the title or description
parameters.help_zh: 标题/描述模糊搜索关键词
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source task. If specified, the flat sub-items of the task are returned
parameters.help_zh: 来源任务ID；指定时返回该任务平铺子项
parameters.name: source_task_id

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

entries.description_en: The entries on the current page. The entryType determines the effective fields: WORK_ITEM maps to item, and TASK_GROUP maps to aggregation fields
entries.description_zh: 当前页条目；entryType 决定生效字段（WORK_ITEM→item / TASK_GROUP→聚合字段）

items.description_en: The entries on the current page. The entryType determines the effective fields: WORK_ITEM maps to item, and TASK_GROUP maps to aggregation fields
items.description_zh: 当前页条目；entryType 决定生效字段（WORK_ITEM→item / TASK_GROUP→聚合字段）

hasMoreChildren.description_en: Indicates whether more child items are available

item.description_en: The content of a regular work item row
